title: Zigzag Path · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Zigzag Path · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Draw a start and finish on opposite sides of a sheet. The lead draws a continuous zigzag path joining them without lifting the pencil. The path connects start to finish and includes at least three changes of direction. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Zigzag Path, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The path connects start to finish and includes at least three changes of direction.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The path connects start to finish and includes at least three changes of direction.
